description: Queensland traffic data (annual and averaged by hour and day) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub and Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Department of Transport and Main Roads, QLD; Transport and Main Roads, Qld. Members: Queensland Traffic Data; Queensland traffic data averaged by hour of day, day of week. Example entry: Queensland average daily traffic volume data for state-controlled roads broken down by hour of day and day of week as an average volume for the year prescribed. Coverage is Queensland, 2010 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-05-13. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
